//: pstack per-role model choices. Deployment policy, not workflow documentation, which is why no model id appears in any skill file.
//how: Take the `subagents` block into ~/.pi/agent/settings.json (user) or .pi/settings.json (project). Delete a line to fall back to the packet's default. Overrides are keyed by agent name, so the port's own agents take their role model here: `pstack-scout` is the `how explorer` seat and `poteto-agent` is every code delegate.
//families: A review or design panel needs two different model families, because same-family seats produce agreement that measures nothing. On this machine the two native families are `deepseek` and `zai-coding-cn`, so a cross-family panel needs no external CLI at all.
//external: The external CLI agents (`codex-exec`, `claude-code`) are an alternative second family, but pi-subagents refuses a `.CMD` batch wrapper on Windows and the `codex` and `claude` entries on PATH are wrappers. Override `runner.command` to an absolute `.exe` path if you want that route.

pstack.//: Role lines read by the ported skills. The names match pstack's pstack-models.mdc roles so the ported skill text stays close to the original.
